title: The ColdFusion Administrator is exposed
summary: The ColdFusion admin console is reachable.  It has a long history of authentication bypass and remote code execution.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("ColdFusion Administrator") or body_contains("CFIDE")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Restrict the admin console to trusted addresses and keep ColdFusion updated.
